Answer: Graphite tips
Detail: In the RBMK reactor design, the control rods had graphite "followers" at the tips to displace water. When the SCRAM button was pressed, these graphite tips entered the core first, briefly increasing reactivity at the bottom of the reactor instead of dampening it, which triggered the final explosion.

7. In the Milgram Experiment, what was the specific 'prod' used by the experimenter when a participant refused to continue?
A. 'You are legally responsible for this'
B. 'The learner is not actually being hurt'
C. 'You will not be paid if you stop'
D. 'The experiment requires that you continue'
